home.mapBody: Explore the Kingdom's commercial buildings as clickable objects, verified rent bands, available space, and area intelligence. Live now in Riyadh, expanding nationwide. The intelligence platform, with the transaction built in.
home.forSub: One platform, three journeys. Each sees the intelligence relevant to it.
home.occB: Find and lease verified space with full context: rent bands, accessibility, and asset-relevant signals before you commit.

home.invB: Site selection and highest-and-best-use: take a parcel and see, with data, whether to build office, retail, hospitality, or mixed-use.
